recentItems.title: Tovera a revelation as La Salle escapes NU to start title defense
recentItems.description:
Joaquin Tovera was a revelation as De La Salle University opened its UAAP Season 89 title defense on a winning note.

The Green Archers rookie fired 22 points on 8-of-11 shooting as La Salle escaped National University, 89-87, for a winning debut on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

recentItems.title: Mga botante sa Bangsamoro, handa na sa halalan | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Handa nang bumoto ang mga mamamayan ng Bangsamoro ngayong Lunes, Setyembre 14, at umaasang magiging tahimik at payapa ang buong halalan.

Ang mga botong papasok sa kauna-unahang Parliamentary Elections ay susubok sa kakayahan ng BARMM na itaguyod ang isang bagong sistemang pampolitika—isang sistemang mas nagpapahalaga sa tunay na representasyon kaysa sa mga tanyag na personalidad at dinastiya. 

Matapos ang deka-dekadang tunggalian at masalimuot na politika, inaasahang magbubukas ito ng bagong kabanata sa mayaman at makulay na kasaysayan ng Bangsamoro.

recentItems.title: TIMELINE: Creation of PH's Bangsamoro autonomous region ahead of first parliamentary election
recentItems.description:
Residents of the southern Philippine region of Bangsamoro are set to vote in their first parliamentary election on Monday (September 14), marking the final step in the transition from the appointed Bangsamoro Transition Authority to an elected regional government.

The vote is a key milestone in the 2014 peace agreement between Manila and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), the country's largest Muslim separatist group, which ended a decades-long insurgency in Mindanao.

The peace deal sought to end a conflict that killed more than 120,000 people and displaced about 2 million.
